rules.description: Fund 5-Year Rolling Return Average must exceed Benchmark Average

rules.label: Sharpe Ratio
rules.description: Fund Sharpe Ratio must exceed Benchmark Sharpe Ratio

result.fundName: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Growth Plan

insights: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Growth Plan consistently outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 1.98% (17.31% vs 15.33%).
Chance of beating benchmark is 58.6% — moderate consistency, below the 70% Golden Triangle threshold.
Sharpe ratio is near parity (0.57 vs 0.49) — similar risk-adjusted efficiency.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.97, volatility within 2% of the index.
Positive alpha of 1.53% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.41).
Drawdown profile is similar to benchmark (-37.57% vs -37.92%).
Rolling return range spans -28.23% to 91.69% (119.92 pp spread) — consistency score 75.
Failed criteria: Chance of Beating Benchmark.
